rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and thinned zona, but it overstates certainty about a distinct compact ICM and cohesive uniform TE from this single image and mentions possible herniation/multinucleation not clearly visible.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, diagnosis, sperm factors, BMI, endometrium, and first-cycle status with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, especially around age-related aneuploidy limiting prognosis despite good morphology, though there are minor inconsistencies between implantation and clinical pregnancy percentages and some overinterpretation of blastulation concerns from limited data.

Mostly aligned on SET and counseling, but some recommendations are not strongly guideline-based or are overstated, such as routine aggressive dual-route progesterone, low-dose aspirin, fresh transfer preference, and broad endorsement of PGT-A as clearly beneficial.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer, counseling, and future-cycle options, though some suggestions are more speculative than case-specific and would benefit from stronger evidence framing.
